h: Champions grow up here, you know
p: Stevenage has produced at least one world-class competitor: Lewis Hamilton grew up in the town before going on to become a Formula One world champion. Nobody's promising your round of crazy golf will launch a sporting career, but it's a fun fact to wheel out when someone in your group takes it all a bit too seriously.

The town was designated as Britain's first new town in 1946, and its centre was one of the first purpose-built pedestrian shopping areas in the country. Look out for the clock tower and the fountain in the Town Square, both part of that original post-war design and now a well-loved bit of local heritage. The Gordon Craig Theatre in town puts on pantos, comedy and touring shows if you want to round off the day with a bit of entertainment.

When it comes to planning your putt, think about an hour for a typical round. Large parties take longer, so if you're bringing a birthday crowd, factor in time for food and drinks too. Get there a few minutes early, keep coats and bags with one person, and agree from the off whether a ball bouncing back off a wall counts as a do-over. It doesn't, but agree anyway.

For a change of scene, the old market town of Hitchin is just up the road with its timber-framed buildings and pretty market square, and Stevenage FC fans can catch a match at Broadhall Way. Easy add-ons, all close by.
